description: Shell script for testing handling of invalid or badly named git ref names, including operations like fast-import, branch creation, renaming, deletion, and ref verification, with focus on ref name validation and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, runs commands, and checks outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the previous command failed.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in output or error.
